description: Prepare creating a subname for the user to sign in their own wallet, e.g. 'Create pay.alice.eth for 0xabc… with its ETH address set'. Nothing is sent. The account must control the parent name. Can set the owner, records, resolver and expiry; fuses apply to wrapped ENSv1 parents and roles to ENSv2 parents. Returns the steps, whether the account may make the change, plain signing instructions and the unsigned calls.

account.description: Account that will sign the transactions: an address (0x…) or an ENS name

fuses.description: NameWrapper fuses to burn on the subname (wrapped parents); permanent

items.description: NameWrapper fuse, e.g. cannotUnwrap, cannotTransfer, parentCannotControl

name.description: Full subname to create, e.g. pay.alice.eth

owner.description: Who will own the subname. Default: the account

addresses.description: Addresses by coin, e.g. { eth: '0x…', btc: 'bc1…' }; null deletes

contentHash.description: Content hash URI, e.g. ipfs://…; null deletes

texts.description: Text records by key, e.g. { url: 'https://…', 'com.github': 'alice' }; null deletes

resolver.description: own (default): a new resolver for the subname; parent: the parent's resolver; none; or a resolver address

roles.description: ENSv2 roles the owner gets on the subname

items.description: ENSv2 registry role, e.g. setResolver, setSubregistry, canTransfer, renew

name: create_subname

calls.description: Unsigned calls, in order, for the account's wallet

eth.description: ETH the calls send, besides gas

raw.description: Exact amount in the smallest unit

gas.description: Gas limit of the steps that can be checked now

deploys.description: Contracts the plan deploys, at addresses known in advance

issues.description: Why a checked step would fail

plan.description: Handle of this plan for get_plan; pass it back unchanged

requirements.description: What the account needs before signing, e.g. a token balance

signing.description: How to sign the steps, in plain words

checked.description: A step that depends on earlier ones can only be checked once they confirm

willSucceed.description: Whether the steps that can be checked now would succeed if signed now

title: Prepare creating a subname
